## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Aero upgrade hub states that Aerodrome and Velodrome became Aero on October 21, 2026 at 8:00 PM EDT, equivalent to October 22 at 00:00 UTC. (low confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview
- [statement] Aero identifies MetaDEX03 as its DEX operating system from Dromos Labs; the public MetaDEX repository covers AMM pools, voting escrow, gauges, rewards, cross-chain messaging, Metarouter, and Relay. (medium confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview · also: https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-public
- [statement] The upgrade hub lists Base among the seven launch networks, together with Ethereum Mainnet, OP Mainnet, Arc, Ink, Robinhood Chain, and Arbitrum. (low confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview
- [statement] sAERO is staked AERO replacing veAERO and veVELO; its holders direct AERO Rewards to pools and earn Exchange Revenue from those pools. (low confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview
- [statement] The upgrade hub and Bitget migration notice agree that old AERO converts to new AERO at 1:1, while each VELO (called VELODROME by Bitget) converts to 0.044 new AERO. (medium confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview · also: https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603898873
- [statement] The upgrade hub says legacy Aerodrome and Velodrome emissions stopped at launch and that earning new AERO Rewards as an LP requires upgrading. (low confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Aero protocol overview
- [statement] Bitget's October 27 notice scheduled its AERO deposit and withdrawal suspension for November 2, 2026 at 03:00 UTC; this is the exchange migration schedule, distinct from the protocol launch. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603898873 · keywords: Aero protocol overview · also: https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt
- [statement] The MetaDEX repository says new protocol files use Dromos Restricted Use License 1.0, which does not allow production use; each version converts to GPL-2.0-or-later five years after first public distribution, while interfaces are MIT unless they inherit GPL. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-public · keywords: Aero protocol overview
